Resolves #21927
Related: #21140, #21346, #21936, #21942, neomjs/pages#183

Renews `examples/gantt/basic` ("Community Garden Plan") from one phase and four bare tasks into a three-phase, twelve-task garden build (`Site & raised beds`, `Water & paths`, `Soil & planting`) with rolled-up phase spans and progress (`rollupParents: true`), nine finish-to-start links (including two cross-phase links into and out of the `Water & beds ready` milestone diamond), a pinned `now` line (`2026-11-12T11:30:00Z`) aligned with task completion, and paired `960 × 540` dark and light covers on [neomjs/pages#183](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/183).

Evidence: L3 (headless Chromium E2E across all 11 specs loading `gantt/basic` + 5-theme error sweep + deterministic two-pass `960 × 540` @ `4/3` cover captures + two swapped-order cold-reader visual audits) → L3 required (#21927 AC-1..AC-6). Residual: AC-5, Residual-Owner: #21942.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline check-class-module-scope, check-engine-brain-boundary, check-examples-body-only, check-file-sizes, check-package-contents, check-relative-links, check-theme-surfaces, E2eCiSelection.spec.mjs, CaptureExamples.spec.mjs ran.

## Deltas from ticket

- Enabled `rollupParents: true` on `TaskStore` (`#21922`) so the three phase summary bars derive their spans and weighted progress live as tasks move or resize, and adjusted `pxPerMinute` (`0.12` → `0.10`, `144 px/day`) + `rowHeight: 37` (`barMarginPct: 10`) so all 15 rows and 12 tasks fit cleanly at `1440 × 900` while 11 rows (all three phase headers plus the milestone) frame cleanly at `960 × 540`.
- Added `await expect(design).toHaveAttribute('aria-label', /01:00/)` in `BasicNL.spec.mjs` so the resize gesture waits for `ArrowRight`'s cascaded DOM patch before sampling `design`'s handle rect, and updated `DAY_PX` (`144`) and `LINKS` in `LeadingColumnsNL.spec.mjs`.
- Included `gantt-basic-14-light.jpg` alongside `gantt-basic-14.jpg` in [neomjs/pages#183](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/183) (`hasLightCover: true` activation tracked in `#21942` after Pages deploy).

Frame critique: Both cold readers flagged (1) `build-ready` crossing `Water & paths` and `Lay gravel paths`, (2) a `4px` sliver of row 12 peeking above the `960 × 540` horizontal scrollbar, and (3) `Build the beds` progress lagging the `Thu 12` `now` line — all three are fixed in the shipped `74676fd1ef` frames above by moving `water-ready` to open `Soil & planting` (`Fri 13 00:00`) after `Build the beds` (`Thu 12 18:00`, `65%`) and `Lay gravel paths` (`Thu 12 16:00`, `65%`) at `rowHeight: 37`. Remaining cold-reader notes on pre-existing engine/template surfaces — fixed `220 px` `Task` column share on `390 px` phone (`LeadingColumnsNL` pins `TASK_WIDTH = 220`), `9 Nov` current-week header accent, `.neo-gantt-milestone-label` surface mix, and the `1 px` tree toggle helper-line offset — are out of scope (`#21927` forbids engine changes; tree helper line tracked in `#21966`).

Surfaced the bar-crossing vertical connector and `960 × 540` bottom-edge sliver (both fixed prior to commit at `74676fd1ef`).
- **Reader 2 (`4eb8ed20`, A = branch, B = `dev`):** Desktop `8/10` vs `4.5/10`, Phone `5/10` vs `3/10`, Covers `7/10` (light) & `7/10` (dark); Candidate A won decisively whole-frame on both viewports. Surfaced the same connector crossing, bottom-edge crop, and `Build the beds` progress alignment (all three fixed at `74676fd1ef`).

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** contained. This changes the plan's seed data, its scale and two specs, and teaches no architectural concept: the Gantt, its stores and the link router are used as they are.

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:** The claim is AC-1: the example opens on three phases, twelve tasks, nine links and a milestone. At `74676fd1ef`, in a fresh browser context, it shows 3 summary bars, 1 milestone and 9 link arrows. All 7 required checks are green. The first frame at 960 × 540 hashes byte-identical to the pages #183 covers in both Neo themes.

I looked for a visitor who would open a different plan, and found one, narrower than it first looked. `loadProject()` replaces both stores with whatever is saved under `neo-examples-gantt-project-plan-v1`, and this PR keeps that key. I seeded the pre-renewal plan under it, and the head then opened 1 summary bar ("Community garden"), 0 milestones and 2 links. No release has carried this example, though: it arrived on Nov 13 (`a07f581f13`) and 13.4.0 has none. So only browser profiles that edited it on a dev build meet the old garden, and no neomjs.com visitor does.

**Optional, before the merge:** bump the key to `…-v2`. It is one line, and it means anyone who demos from a dev profile opens the renewed plan the new covers show. Not blocking.

**Findings:** None.
